title: Titan Two Device NEW Model [Programmable Scripts, Macros, Mods, Remapping, Keyboard, Mouse] Advanced Crossover Gaming Adapter and Converter for PlayStation 4 PS3 Xbox One 360 Nintendo Switch and more

reviews.title: Excellent product
reviews.body: This thing is exactly what I needed. Like many other PS4 HOTAS users, I was so frustrated with that device and after several died within weeks of using them I wasn’t about to buy another. For the same price, I took a shot at this adapter to see if I could get my nice T.16000M working on the PS4 for Elite:Dangerous. While it has taken some doing, I finally have everything set up and working better than the HOTAS4 ever did in the game. The Titan recognizes all inputs from the T.16k except for the pinky knob axis on the throttle side, and it also doesn’t recognize the 2-pedal axis from the rudder pedals, although it does recognize the axes coming in from each individual pedal.If your desired input device has only 1 USB connection this should be a relatively simple setup to determine your outputs through the GTunerIV software. If your desired device uses 2 or more USB input connections then you will likely need to utilize the scripting function of the software to get everything the way you like it. I’m not a coder or anything, but I do have some experience with scripting in AutoHotkey on the PC, so the concepts are very similar. The GPC2 language is a bit different than that but the commands are pretty self-explanatory and there are good resources on the consoletuner website to help you figure things out. Also there are a multitude of premade script files on there uploaded by other users so depending on your input device and the game you want to play you may find exactly what you need already exists, the downloads are free. The recent beta firmware release also is a huge improvement over the previous since it allows you to assign different actions to the same button label depending on which USB input it’s coming through. So happy I found this!

reviews.title: Works with the Switch 2 (with a switch 1 controller)
reviews.body: Works well using a switch 1 controller together with switch 2. Adding the bluetooth module also works. The software required to use the titan two was released before the switch 2. So I doubt a switch 2 controller will work with the device.

reviews.title: Absolutely love this product
reviews.body: This thing is just too awesome. I originally bought mine simply to use a DualShock 4 on my other consoles because it’s the only controller that doesn’t hurt my hands/wrists, but the added benefits of things like auto-sprint and dead zone remover have me absolutely in love with my Titan 2. Going on a few months now, haven’t had a single issue, and if rumors are true this will also support the PS5 and Xbox Series X which has me hyped. I highly recommend the T2 to anyone, including people like me, who probably barely scratch the surface of all the missing and presets and whatnot. I might never have played my Xbox again if it weren’t for the T2, and that’s a ton of worth alone. Being able to use a mic no matter what console I use is also huge. Just be aware you must have an official controller for whatever console you’re going to be using, but that said, the controller doesn’t even need to be in great shape, just a working headphone jack and no stick drift and you’re good to go. I will probably always use a T2 from now on, and if a T3 comes out I’ll definitely purchase. Nothing is too expensive if it means avoiding carpal tunnel as an avid gamer. And being able to sprint without mashing my joystick down, in say, a 2 hour game of COD zombies, is a benefit I would pay for again and again. Bravo, ConsoleTuner.

features: Fully programmable and customizable gaming device compatible with PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, Wii U, PlayStation TV, PS4 Remote Play, Xbox One App, Android Systems, Computers and more. Programing Software available for Windows, Mac and iOS.

Use your preferred controller on any compatible gaming system. The Titan Two is an all-in-one gaming device that replaces dozens of gaming adapters, converters and crossover devices found on the market. The Titan Bluetooth Module (sold separately) allow Bluetooth enabled controllers to be used wirelessly with the Titan Two, USB wireless adapters are also supported.

Customize the controller layout accordingly your needs for any game. Exclusive MODs, combos and macros can be easily enabled with a simple drag-and-drop of Gamepacks or community made scripts. No chips to install, no tools required. Create your own scripts, combos and macros at the millisecond precision. Program automated commands in reaction to events. The possibilities are endless.

Play with Keyboard and Mouse on consoles with an unprecedented level of configuration. The Titan Two is fully compliant with the HID standard, making it compatible with virtually any HID gaming devices, such as fight-sticks, steering wheels, joysticks, foot switches, etc.
Package Contents: Titan Two Device, High Quality Micro-USB Cable 40cm (1.3 FT), Quick Setup Guide.
